concerns.text: FR-001 requires a fallback reporting step when fewer than 10 usable samples are obtained, but no task (including T005) specifies generating a descriptive‑only preliminary report. The fallback is missing.
FR-007 mandates a co‑location validation step to verify that each EDS map and its performance record originate from the same device. No task in the list implements or verifies this validation.
FR-008 requires flagging (and optionally excluding) samples where bulk‑averaged EDS maps correlate with surface‑dominated PCE metrics. No task addresses this bulk‑surface discrepancy analysis.
FR-009 calls for estimation of charge‑carrier diffusion lengths (TRPL or empirical calibration) and inclusion in the modeling. No task produces a diffusion‑length CSV or related output.
FR-010 specifies a linearity‑diagnostic (residual analysis / lack‑of‑fit test) before reporting Pearson results. The modeling task T006 does not mention performing this diagnostic.
SC-004 requires the ingestion success rate to be asserted as ≥ 95 %. The verification steps for T002 only check file existence and schema compliance, not the quantitative success‑rate threshold.
The implementation plan adds a composite‑metric sensitivity analysis (variance‑weighted and expert‑assigned composites) that is not covered by any task in tasks.md, creating uncaptured scope.
